title: Dither
description: Render any dithercn component as a dithered visual: backgrounds (aurora, plasma, globe, starfield and more), charts, interface pieces, display text, dithered images, or a custom GLSL field, in theme colours, with an optional title.
author: Harald Bregu

component.description: Which dithercn component to render. Use shader for a custom GLSL field.

props.description: Props for the component, as JSON. Every prop is optional unless listed here; defaults already look good. Colours: palette names ink, blue, purple, green, pink, orange, red, grey (follow light and dark), or CSS colours. Common optional props: color, accent, background, speed, animate, matrix (bayer2, bayer4, bayer8, blue-noise), cell (dot size in px), fill (gradient, dotted, hatched, solid), bloom (off, low, high). className takes common Tailwind utilities: spacing, sizes, max-w, text size and weight, rounded. Backgrounds need no props. shader: field (GLSL defining float field(vec2 uv, vec2 res, float t) returning a tone 0 to 1), palette (paper then ink colours). Charts: area-chart, bar-chart, line-chart: data (rows), x (category key), series ([{label, value: row key, color}]). sparkline: data (numbers), label. heatmap: data ([{date: "YYYY-MM-DD", value}]). donut-chart: data ([{label, value, color}]), label. radar-chart: axes (names), series ([{label, values: one per axis}]). gauge: value, label, min, max, unit. progress-bar: label, value, max. uptime-bar: label, days ([{date, uptime: 0 to 1, status: up|degraded|down|none, note}]). stat-card: label, value, delta, trend (numbers). Interface: dither-button: children (text), variant, size. avatar: name, size, status. dither-card: children (text), glow. divider: label. skeleton: shape (block, text, circle), lines. loader: variant, size. empty-state: title, description. not-found: code, title, description. Text: dither-text: children (text), fill (gradient, noise, dotted, hatched, solid). dissolve-text, scramble-text: children (text). dither-number: value, prefix, suffix, size. Images (src must be a URL the page can load, ideally a data: URL): dither-image, image-compare, scroll-reveal-image, dithered-logo: src, alt. logo-marquee: logos ([{src, alt}]).

title.description: Optional heading. Omit when no title is needed.
